_comment: Season-final card batch, 2026: every player who wore the uniform this summer, active roster and departed alike, with his role in one reviewed place. Names are the BOX-SCORE spelling, which is what scripts/player-season-data.py resolves - one exception: Matt Scott is 'Matthew Scott' in the Gators box and 'Matt Scott' at Brazos Valley, and the card prints the club's spelling.
_roles: A player with appearances in both roles gets two cards only when both are substantial. That rule is the owner's, set on the active-roster batch (Jack Garcille, 10 batting / 9 pitching), and it is applied to the departed players here too: Levy (9/8), Pierce (10/6) and McKinley (12/5) get both cards; Griffin Hebert (13 batting / 2 pitching) and Griffin Cooley (6 / 1) get the batter card only. An earlier unsent batch gave those two a pitching card built on one or two outings.

_open.Landon Hennen: Batter card only: the seed shows 4 batting games and no pitching line. An earlier batch produced a pitching card for him; unconfirmed whether he ever pitched. Box spells him both Hennen and Hennan - the script handles both.

_full_season.Matt Scott: Full-season card by owner decision: 22 Brazos Valley games + 10 Gators games, one set of totals, with a Tm column in the game log marking BV vs LC. His Brazos Valley boxes are in data/prior-stint-seed.json. The 7/8 Brazos Valley game is EXCLUDED: the league's transactions log has him de-activated 7/07 with Eddie Castillo activated into his #8 the same day, so he was not eligible; the box still prints his name and Presto's season line inherits that error.
